what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 554891 Eritrean refugees, and Ethiopia hosts the largest share, 29.2%.
Sudan, Germany and Switzerland are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, at war level, and again in 2016.
It records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea with the EIJM - AS in 1997, 1999 and 2003.
The sources here don't give a cause for the rise in refugee numbers after 2012.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 1991 to 2002 and 2012 to 2025.
UNHCR's figure rose from 400 in 1979 to a peak of 559853 in 2023.
Returns to Eritrea were highest in 1992 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from Eritrea are counted in a separate series.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
